approvals_human_decision.name: approvals_human_decision
approvals_human_decision.value: "approvals"."state" not in ('approved', 'rejected') or (coalesce("approvals"."decided_by_kind" in ('staff', 'client'), false) and "approvals"."decided_by_id" is not null and "approvals"."decided_at" is not null)

approvals_invalidation_reason.name: approvals_invalidation_reason
approvals_invalidation_reason.value: "approvals"."state" <> 'invalidated' or ("approvals"."invalidated_at" is not null and "approvals"."invalidation_reason" is not null)

assistance_runs_task_source.name: assistance_runs_task_source
assistance_runs_task_source.value: ("assistance_runs"."task" = 'locale.draft' and "assistance_runs"."source_type" = 'listing_revision' and "assistance_runs"."target_locale" is not null and "assistance_runs"."target_locale" <> 'bg') or ("assistance_runs"."task" = 'intake.extract' and "assistance_runs"."source_type" = 'property_fact_revision' and "assistance_runs"."target_locale" is null) or ("assistance_runs"."task" in ('inquiry_summary','reply_draft','task_draft') and "assistance_runs"."source_type" = 'inquiry' and "assistance_runs"."target_locale" is null)

assistance_runs_usage.name: assistance_runs_usage
assistance_runs_usage.value: "assistance_runs"."input_tokens" >= 0 and "assistance_runs"."output_tokens" >= 0 and "assistance_runs"."reserved_cost_micros" >= 0 and ("assistance_runs"."actual_cost_micros" is null or "assistance_runs"."actual_cost_micros" >= 0)

assistance_runs_review.name: assistance_runs_review
assistance_runs_review.value: "assistance_runs"."state" not in ('accepted', 'rejected') or ("assistance_runs"."reviewed_by_id" is not null and "assistance_runs"."reviewed_at" is not null)

case_access_requests_target.name: case_access_requests_target
case_access_requests_target.value: ("case_access_requests"."kind" = 'invite' and "case_access_requests"."target_email" is not null and "case_access_requests"."target_name" is not null and "case_access_requests"."requested_role" is not null and "case_access_requests"."target_participant_id" is null) or ("case_access_requests"."kind" = 'remove' and "case_access_requests"."target_participant_id" is not null and "case_access_requests"."target_email" is null and "case_access_requests"."target_name" is null and "case_access_requests"."requested_role" is null)

case_access_requests_decision.name: case_access_requests_decision
case_access_requests_decision.value: "case_access_requests"."state" = 'pending' or ("case_access_requests"."decided_by_id" is not null and "case_access_requests"."decided_at" is not null and "case_access_requests"."client_outcome" is not null)

document_requests_cancellation.name: document_requests_cancellation
document_requests_cancellation.value: "document_requests"."cancelled_at" is null or ("document_requests"."cancelled_by_id" is not null and "document_requests"."client_outcome" is not null)

case_process_item_human.name: case_process_item_human
case_process_item_human.value: "case_process_items"."result" = 'pending' or ("case_process_items"."reviewed_by_id" is not null and "case_process_items"."reviewed_at" is not null and "case_process_items"."reason" is not null)

process_policy_revocation.name: process_policy_revocation
process_policy_revocation.value: "process_policies"."revoked_at" is null or "process_policies"."revocation_reason" is not null

service_agreement_start_evidence.name: service_agreement_start_evidence
service_agreement_start_evidence.value: "service_agreements"."express_start_requested_at" is null or ("service_agreements"."express_start_evidence_version_id" is not null and "service_agreements"."express_start_evidence_digest" is not null)

appointments_confirmed_slot.name: appointments_confirmed_slot
appointments_confirmed_slot.value: "appointments"."state" not in ('confirmed', 'reschedule_requested', 'completed', 'no_show') or ("appointments"."confirmed_starts_at" is not null and "appointments"."confirmed_ends_at" is not null and "appointments"."confirmed_ends_at" > "appointments"."confirmed_starts_at")

appointments_confirmed_checks.name: appointments_confirmed_checks
appointments_confirmed_checks.value: "appointments"."state" <> 'confirmed' or ("appointments"."host_id" is not null and "appointments"."property_access" = 'confirmed' and "appointments"."external_busy_checked_at" is not null)

document_versions_scan_sealed_bytes.name: document_versions_scan_sealed_bytes
document_versions_scan_sealed_bytes.value: "document_versions"."scan" = 'pending' or ("document_versions"."sealed_key" is not null and "document_versions"."sha256" is not null)

document_versions_reviewed_by_human.name: document_versions_reviewed_by_human
document_versions_reviewed_by_human.value: "document_versions"."state" <> 'reviewed' or ("document_versions"."review_type" is not null and "document_versions"."reviewed_by_id" is not null)

messages_sent_only_when_approved.name: messages_sent_only_when_approved
messages_sent_only_when_approved.value: "messages"."direction" = 'inbound' or "messages"."state" = 'draft' or ("messages"."approved_digest" is not null and ("messages"."approval_id" is not null or "messages"."kind" = 'service_message'))

messages_logical_send.name: messages_logical_send
messages_logical_send.value: "messages"."direction" = 'inbound' or "messages"."state" in ('draft', 'approved') or "messages"."logical_send_id" is not null

grants_service_drafts_only.name: grants_service_drafts_only
grants_service_drafts_only.value: "grants"."service_name" is null or coalesce("grants"."role" = 'ai_service', false) or coalesce("grants"."capability" in ('ai.draft', 'translation.draft', 'message.draft'), false)

grants_record_scope.name: grants_record_scope
grants_record_scope.value: ("grants"."record_id" is null) or ("grants"."record_type" is not null)

inbound_email_decided.name: inbound_email_decided
inbound_email_decided.value: "inbound_emails"."state" = 'triage' or ("inbound_emails"."decided_by_id" is not null and "inbound_emails"."decided_at" is not null and "inbound_emails"."decision_note" is not null)

inbound_email_assigned.name: inbound_email_assigned
inbound_email_assigned.value: "inbound_emails"."state" <> 'assigned' or ("inbound_emails"."case_id" is not null and "inbound_emails"."sender_party_id" is not null and "inbound_emails"."message_id" is not null)

localized_revisions_approved_by_human.name: localized_revisions_approved_by_human
localized_revisions_approved_by_human.value: "localized_revisions"."state" <> 'approved_for_source' or ("localized_revisions"."reviewed_by_id" is not null and "localized_revisions"."approval_id" is not null and "localized_revisions"."reviewed_facts" is not null)

media_assets_scan_sealed_bytes.name: media_assets_scan_sealed_bytes
media_assets_scan_sealed_bytes.value: "media_assets"."scan" = 'pending' or ("media_assets"."sealed_key" is not null and "media_assets"."sha256" is not null)

property_relationships_reviewed_authorit.name: property_relationships_reviewed_authority
property_relationships_reviewed_authorit.value: "property_relationships"."authority" <> 'reviewed' or ("property_relationships"."authority_reviewed_by_id" is not null and "property_relationships"."authority_reviewed_at" is not null)

subscriptions_alert_criteria.name: subscriptions_alert_criteria
subscriptions_alert_criteria.value: ("subscriptions"."purpose" = 'search_alerts') = ("subscriptions"."criteria" is not null and "subscriptions"."frequency" is not null)

destination_deliveries_verified_evidence.name: destination_deliveries_verified_evidence
destination_deliveries_verified_evidence.value: "destination_deliveries"."state" not in ('verified', 'withdrawn') or "destination_deliveries"."verified_at" is not null

privacy_requests_in_progress_verified.name: privacy_requests_in_progress_verified
privacy_requests_in_progress_verified.value: "privacy_requests"."state" in ('received', 'verifying', 'rejected') or ("privacy_requests"."verified_at" is not null and "privacy_requests"."responsible_id" is not null)

privacy_requests_completed_evidence.name: privacy_requests_completed_evidence
privacy_requests_completed_evidence.value: "privacy_requests"."state" <> 'completed' or ("privacy_requests"."completion_evidence" is not null and "privacy_requests"."legal_hold_disposition" is not null and "privacy_requests"."completed_at" is not null)

locale_settings_indexable_approved.name: locale_settings_indexable_approved
locale_settings_indexable_approved.value: not "locale_settings"."indexable" or ("locale_settings"."enabled" and "locale_settings"."indexable_approval_id" is not null)

case_participants_reviewed_authority.name: case_participants_reviewed_authority
case_participants_reviewed_authority.value: "case_participants"."authority" <> 'reviewed' or ("case_participants"."authority_reviewed_by_id" is not null and "case_participants"."authority_reviewed_at" is not null)

cases_stage_matches_kind.name: cases_stage_matches_kind
cases_stage_matches_kind.value:
("cases"."kind" in ('buyer', 'tenant') and "cases"."stage" in ('needs_agreed', 'evaluating', 'viewing', 'proposal_preparation', 'proposal_active', 'coordination', 'completed'))
        or ("cases"."kind" in ('seller', 'landlord') and "cases"."stage" in ('request_received', 'scope_authority_review', 'assessment', 'instructions_agreed', 'preparing', 'marketing', 'proposal_coordination', 'completion_handover'))
        or ("cases"."kind" = 'service_intake' and "cases"."stage" in ('request_received', 'consultation', 'concluded'))

cases_active_owned.name: cases_active_owned
cases_active_owned.value: "cases"."disposition" <> 'active' or ("cases"."owner_id" is not null and ("cases"."next_action" is not null or ("cases"."waiting_on" is not null and "cases"."review_at" is not null)))

cases_paused_dependency.name: cases_paused_dependency
cases_paused_dependency.value: "cases"."disposition" <> 'paused' or ("cases"."disposition_reason" is not null and "cases"."waiting_on" is not null and "cases"."review_at" is not null)

cases_closed_outcome.name: cases_closed_outcome
cases_closed_outcome.value: "cases"."disposition" <> 'closed' or ("cases"."closure_outcome" is not null and "cases"."commitment_dispositions" is not null)

interests_declined_reason.name: interests_declined_reason
interests_declined_reason.value: "interests"."state" not in ('declined', 'unavailable') or "interests"."reason" is not null

seller_instructions_agreed_evidence.name: seller_instructions_agreed_evidence
seller_instructions_agreed_evidence.value: "seller_instructions"."state" <> 'agreed' or ("seller_instructions"."agreed_at" is not null and "seller_instructions"."recorded_by_id" is not null and "seller_instructions"."commission_terms" is not null and jsonb_array_length("seller_instructions"."evidence_document_ids") > 0)

tasks_waiting_names_dependency.name: tasks_waiting_names_dependency
tasks_waiting_names_dependency.value: "tasks"."state" <> 'waiting' or ("tasks"."waiting_on" is not null and "tasks"."follow_up_at" is not null)

tasks_done_records_outcome.name: tasks_done_records_outcome
tasks_done_records_outcome.value: "tasks"."state" <> 'done' or ("tasks"."outcome_note" is not null and "tasks"."completed_at" is not null)

tasks_done_evidence.name: tasks_done_evidence
tasks_done_evidence.value: "tasks"."state" <> 'done' or not "tasks"."evidence_required" or "tasks"."evidence_ids" is not null
